trafficDescription: Menya amategeko y'umuhanda mu Rwanda kugira ngo utware neza.
JobDescription: Jya ubona amakuru agezweho y'akazi gahari.
testDescription: Kora ikizamini cy'imyitozo cyo uyu munsi ubone uko uhagaze.
aboutLine1: Urubuga rwacu rutanga ubufasha bwuzuye ku batwara ibinyabiziga mu Rwanda, harimo amategeko agezweho y'umuhanda, ibizamini by'imyitozo, n'amahirwe y'akazi mu rwego rwo gutwara abantu n'ibintu.
visionText: Gushyiraho inzira zizewe mu Rwanda binyuze mu kwigisha abatwara ibinyabiziga no kubaha ibikoresho bibafasha gutsinda.
missionText: Gufasha buri muntu wifuza gutwara kubona ubumenyi bwizewe, imyitozo y'ibizamini ku gihe, n'amahirwe y'akazi mu rwego rwo gutwara abantu n'ibintu.
drivingText1: Urubuga rutanga amategeko agezweho y'umuhanda, ibizamini by’imyitozo, n’amakuru y’akazi kugira ngo utsinde neza kandi ubone amahirwe mu bijyanye no gutwara mu Rwanda.
drivingText2: Niba wifuza kwihugura mu gutwara cyangwa kumenya amakuru mashya ku kazi, turi hano ngo tukuganirize buri ntambwe yose.
